Why the R0-R7 driver refused at its own reproduction gate, and what each candidate tolerance would catch. Computes no registered statistic. The flat RECON_TOL of 1e-06 is exceeded by exactly one drug of 795, levofloxacin, whose deposited proj_shrna is 8.6575 and whose error is 1.139e-06, which is 2.21 float32 ULPs at that magnitude. P_shrna spans 0.6424 to 16.95 and one float32 ULP at 16.95 is 1.01e-06, so a flat absolute 1e-06 is below float32 resolution at the top of the range. Max relative error 1.96e-07 for P, median error 0.505 ULP. The elementwise float32 rule Amendment 2 already registers, |a-b| <= 1e-8 + 1e-6|b|, holds for all 795 drugs on all three invariant quantities. Three injected-error ladders measure what each rule catches: the flat rule is uninformative for P because it fails on the unperturbed computation, while the elementwise rule holds at 1e-07 injected and fails at 1e-06. For E the elementwise rule is strictly more sensitive, 1e-05 against 1e-04. D is a mean pairwise cosine and is invariant to every rescaling, so only the ladder that moves a gene coordinate reaches it; there both rules fire at 1e-03. The inputs were sealed before the R0-R7 launch; the wrapper is re-sealed here because the diagnostic stages were added to it after that seal. No tolerance has been changed.

Where the reproduction difference comes from, measured before any tolerance is amended, as round 23 required. Two hypotheses refuted by their own measurements: the float32 accumulator in the retired loader's mean (legacy float32 and float64 accumulation differ from each other by about 1e-9 and both sit about 1e-6 from deposited), and a float32 projection path (no dtype route reproduces deposited below the 1e-7 relative floor). What holds: context membership is identical between routes for every focus drug, and the difference is spread rather than localized, 6 of levofloxacin's 21 context pairs above half the maximum per-pair difference of 5.66e-07. The two modern routes agree with each other 5 to 10 times better than either agrees with deposited. So the refusal hides no localized implementation discrepancy. The two-layer measurement then settles the design: the retired route reproduces the deposited analysis under the frozen flat absolute 1e-06 on all 795 drugs and all three invariant quantities, 0 over, maximum normalized residual 0.122 for P, 0.446 for E, 0.128 for D; the authoritative rebuild fails that flat rule for one drug and satisfies the elementwise float32 rule on all 795, maximum normalized residual 0.195, 0.421 and 0.129. The frozen tolerance is therefore correct for the comparison it was registered for and is not loosened. No registered statistic computed, no tolerance changed.
